have h_inf : Set.Infinite {(k, m, n) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ | 3 ≤ k ∧ n + k ≤ m ∧ lcmInterval m (k + 1) < lcmInterval n k} := by
  -- Since we need to prove infinitude, we can show that for any N, there is some k >= N.
  intro h_fin
  have h_bdd : BddAbove (image (fun (k, m, n) => k) {(k, m, n) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ | 3 ≤ k ∧ n + k ≤ m ∧ lcmInterval m (k + 1) < lcmInterval n k}) :=
    h_fin.image (fun (k, m, n) => k) |>.bddAbove
  rcases h_bdd with ⟨B, hB⟩
  have h_contra := hB ⟨3, 47, 36, by decide⟩
  exact not_lt_of_ge h_contra (by decide)
exact h_inf
